## What's Changed
* Pin test workflow runners to ubuntu-24.04 by @scarroll32 in https://github.com/activerecord-hackery/ransack/pull/1802
* Bump nokogiri from 1.19.4 to 1.19.5 in /docs in the bundler group across 1 directory by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/activerecord-hackery/ransack/pull/1801
* Bump addressable from 2.9.0 to 2.9.1 in /docs in the bundler group across 1 directory by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/activerecord-hackery/ransack/pull/1803
* Fix mismatched indentation in Ransack::Nodes::Node by @viktorianer in https://github.com/activerecord-hackery/ransack/pull/1804
* Accept strong parameters in the node builders; follow-ups to #1804 by @scarroll32 in https://github.com/activerecord-hackery/ransack/pull/1805
* Test the newest Ruby patch releases; update stale Ruby docs and gem authors by @scarroll32 in https://github.com/activerecord-hackery/ransack/pull/1806
* Version 6.1.1 by @scarroll32 in https://github.com/activerecord-hackery/ransack/pull/1807

## New Contributors
* @viktorianer made their first contribution in https://github.com/activerecord-hackery/ransack/pull/1804

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/activerecord-hackery/ransack/compare/v6.1.0...v6.1.1

detail.readme: # Ransack > Search everywhere and in a hurry! [![Build Status](https://github.com/activerecord-hackery/ransack/workflows/test/badge.svg)](https://github.com/activerecord-hackery/ransack/actions) [![Gem Version](https://badge.fury.io/rb/ransack.svg)](http://badge.fury.io/rb/ransack) Ransack adds **searching and sorting to your Rails application** with plain Ruby and ERB, without a search server or any other infrastructure. Ransack is supported for Rails 8.1 on Ruby 3.3 and later, on Postgres, MySQL, Trilogy and SQLite. ```ruby gem 'ransack' ``` ```ruby @q = Post.ransack(params[:q]) @posts = @q.result ``` ```erb <%= search_form_for @q do |f| %> <%= f.search_field :title_cont %> <% end %> <%= sort_link(@q, :published_at) %> ``` ## Documentation **[activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/)**: [getting started](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/getting-started/), [authorization](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/getting-started/authorization/), [predicates](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/getting-started/search-matches/), [upgrading](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/getting-started/upgrading/) and more. The site is built from the Markdown under [`docs/`](docs/). ## We love ❤️ these projects * [ActiveAdmin](https://github.com/activeadmin/activeadmin), the Rails admin framework whose filters are built on Ransack * [Avo](https://github.com/avo-hq/avo), admin panels and internal tools for Rails, with search powered by Ransack * [Spree](https://github.com/spree/spree), the open source commerce platform, which uses Ransack for its search and filtering * [Solidus](https://github.com/solidusio/solidus), the open source eCommerce framework, which uses Ransack for its search and filtering * [mobility-ransack](https://github.com/shioyama/mobility-ransack), which searches attributes translated with [Mobility](https://github.com/shioyama/mobility) * [ransack_memory](https://github.com/richardrails/ransack_memory), which saves and restores Ransack's search params in the session * [Ransack demo](https://github.com/activerecord-hackery/ransack_demo), an app showing advanced search forms built with Ransack ## Getting help and contributing * Questions belong in [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/activerecord-hackery/ransack/discussions). * Reproducible bugs belong in [Issues](https://github.com/activerecord-hackery/ransack/issues). Read the [Contributing Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) first; a failing test is the best bug report. * Report security vulnerabilities privately, through GitHub [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/activerecord-hackery/ransack/security/advisories/new) or the [Tidelift security contact](https://tidelift.com/security). See the [Security Policy](.github/SECURITY.md) for supported versions. Ransack is maintained by volunteers. If it is useful to you, please consider supporting us via [Open Collective](https://opencollective.com/ransack), or through the [Tidelift Subscription](https://tidelift.com/subscription/pkg/rubygems-ransack?utm_source=rubygems-ransack&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=enterprise&utm_term=repo) for commercial support. ## Contributors Ransack is maintained by [Sean Carroll](https://github.com/scarroll32), [Deivid Rodriguez](https://github.com/deivid-rodriguez) and [a great group of contributors](https://github.com/activerecord-hackery/ransack/graphs/contributors). It was created by [Ernie Miller](http://twitter.com/erniemiller). See [Community and support](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/project/community/) for the full list.
